tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are part of your school's drama club and have been assigned the role of event coordinator for an upcoming play. You need to arrange for promotional materials, such as posters and flyers, to be printed and distributed. You want to contact a local print shop to discuss this. Write an email to the print shop manager, Ms. Clark.
bullets: Describe the event and its importance.
Ask about their services for printing promotional materials.
Inquire about the costs and turnaround time for printing.
tasks.subject: Printing Services for Upcoming Play
